value.rationale: The 2023 literature identifies rational negative-feedback dynamics and observes stable and unstable four-cycles numerically. A complete positive-quadrant convergence and saddle-separatrix theorem is a natural substantive gap because numerical phase portraits and linear multipliers do not establish all basins or exclude other recurrent sets. The exact critical n^{-1/2} coefficient and supercritical branch amplitude quantify the global transition and provide reproducible benchmarks for this biological feedback archetype. The smooth exact map is naturally motivated by the original τ→∞ model, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
